title: A structured approach to governance, risk and compliance
lead: Five steps, from understanding where you are to keeping controls effective as things change.

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: Understand your organisation, obligations, systems and existing controls.

steps.title: Identify
steps.description: Find the gaps and risks that matter, and rank them by their effect on you.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Design proportionate controls, policies and documentation to close those gaps.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: Support your team in putting the controls and processes into practice.

steps.title: Monitor & Improve
steps.description: Review how controls perform, track change and keep improving over time.
